processes:task-pr-design-intake-cekxqc.plain_language_name: Open the Demand Model File for Commitment
processes:task-pr-design-intake-cekxqc.plain_language_description: Bringing the demand model together starts with intake: the segment thesis the design serves, the library of interaction patterns, and the criteria the experience must meet. The intake custodian binds the pack to the design file so the consolidation works from one accounted-for set.
processes:task-pr-design-intake-cekxqc.business_purpose: It exists because a committed model is only as sound as the completeness of what fed it.
processes:task-pr-design-intake-cekxqc.practical_context: It opens when the Design-stage pack is handed over for the activity, and it closes with the manifest registered and custody passed to the verification custodian.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function logs the supply paths, capacity register, and lever catalogue into the model design file.

processes:task-pr-design-verify-9jze3t.plain_language_name: Check the Model Inputs Against the Quality Bar
processes:task-pr-design-verify-9jze3t.plain_language_description: Before the model is committed, the verification custodian tests the pack against the bar the experience must meet and the contract for how touchpoints are classified. Deviations are reported with their fixes.
processes:task-pr-design-verify-9jze3t.business_purpose: It exists so the approvers commit a model whose inputs have survived scrutiny.
processes:task-pr-design-verify-9jze3t.practical_context: It starts once the intake manifest is registered, and it ends with the report issued, deviations remediated, and custody passed to the processing custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in the strategy function clears the model inputs against the quality bar before the commitment round.

processes:task-pr-design-transform-x7bvp.plain_language_description: With the certificate in hand, the processing custodian carries out the design: journey stages are mapped, the moments that decide the relationship are identified, touchpoints and their interaction patterns are designed, and the capacity assumptions are modelled. Supply paths, capacity assumptions, and levers are consolidated as a journey artefact ready for confirmation.
processes:task-pr-design-transform-x7bvp.business_purpose: It exists so the scattered design pieces become one document the build can actually work from.
processes:task-pr-design-transform-x7bvp.practical_context: It opens when the verification certificate clears the pack, and it closes with the journey artefact produced and custody passed to the confirmation custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function consolidates the supply paths, capacity assumptions, and levers into the model document.

processes:task-pr-design-confirm-5gtde8.plain_language_description: The confirmation custodian reconciles the journey artefact with the bar the experience must meet and with the contract for how touchpoints are classified. Once aligned, the experience custodian receives the completion confirmation, and it is logged.
processes:task-pr-design-confirm-5gtde8.business_purpose: It exists so the commitment carries a logged acceptance from the person accountable for the model.
processes:task-pr-design-confirm-5gtde8.practical_context: It starts once the journey artefact is produced, and it closes when the acknowledgement is logged and the records custodian receives the file.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian logs the sign-off after the experience custodian acknowledges the completed demand model.

processes:task-pr-design-record-rtbc4t.plain_language_description: After commitment, the records custodian places the design file - manifest, verification report, journey artefact, completion confirmation, and remediation notes - into retention under the schedule for journey-design records, protected against tampering.
